(I)--a sage of the Vaivasvata epoch; (भार्गव); a son of ऋचीक and सत्यवती; to attain a son for himself and for गाधि, he made a चरु to be taken both by his wife and mother-in-law, the latter to get a क्षत्रिय and the former a ब्राह्मण; then he entered the forest for penance; by mistake the चरु intended for the mother was taken by the daughter and vice-versa; ऋचीक understood the mistake and told his wife that a cruel son would be born to her; she implored him to give her a good son; Jamadagni, born to her; produced by eating (जम) the वैष्णवाग्नि.
1: भा. VIII. १३. 5; Br. II. ३२. १०५; ३८. २७; M. 9. २८; १२६. २१; वा. ३२. ४६; ६५. ९३; ९१. ६७ and ८५-86. Vi. IV. 7. ३२-6.
Entertained Arjuna (Haihaya) with the help of his काम- dhenu. The king desired to own her; but on being refused, he took her away by force. She was recovered by his son परशुराम who killed Arjuna. Regretted his son's action in killing the king and found fault with रेणुका his wife who saw Citraratha. He asked his other sons to kill their mother but they declined. परशुराम killed them and his mother to please his father but he requested that they might come back to life to which the sage agreed. But the sons of Arjuna took vengeance and slew the sage in the presence of रेणुका. Through the prowess of his son, Jamadagni got back his body and became the seventh in the ऋषिमण्- डल
2: भा. IX. chh. १५ and १६.
Married रेणुका, daughter of रेणु the youngest son was राम. According to the वायु पुराण रेणुक is also known as कामलि and is said to be the daughter of the इक्ष्वाकु, सुवेणु. Vasumat and others were elders to राम.
3: Ib. IX. १५. ११-13; वा. ९१. ८६.
Officiated in ब्रह्मा's place in the sacrifice of हरिश्चन्द्र;
4: भा. IX. 7. २३.
a मन्त्रकृत्;
5: Br. III. २१ 1; M. १४५. ९९.
a भार्गव gotrakara.
6: M. १९५. १५ and २९.

(II)--a मन्त्रकृत् and a sage; with the sun in माघ and फाल्गुन.
2: Ib. ५२. २०; Vi. II. १०. १६; III. 1. ३२.

(III)--a son of ऊरु and of भृगु gotra;
1: वा. ६४. २५.
Jamadagni भार्गव, one of the seven sages.
2: Ib. १००. १०.

(I)--the sixth human incarnation of विष्णु with विश्वामित्र as पुरोहित in the १९थ् Treta1yuga;
1: Br. III. ७३. ९१; M. ४७. २४४; वा. ८८. १३५.
with the शिशिर sun;
2: Br. II. २३. २०.
served the गोदावरी तीर्थम्।
3: M. २२. ५८.
[page१-648+ ३०]
(II)--the भार्गव, who slew the Saimhi- keya गण. वा. ६८. २२.
--a सुधर्मान God. Br. IV. 1. ६०.
--the tree at इलावृतम् in the हिमालयस्. Br. II. १७. १२; १९. २९; III. २२. ३७; २७. १७; IV. ४३. १७.

--(जाम्बूनदम्) a river of juice of celestial roseapple tree flowing from the top of Merumandara into इलावृत. The earth on its two banks yields fine gold जाम्बू- nada from which jewels are made in heaven; source of जम्बु;
1: भा. V. १६. १९-20; वा. ३५. २६-30.
R. from Candraprabha
2: Br. II. १८. ६९.
in colour like a butterfly.
3: वा. ४६. ३०.
--a son of आप. वा. ६९. ३०.
--a commander of भण्ड to aid विषङ्ग; was killed by नीलपताका. Br. IV. २१. ८०; २५. २९, ९८.
--a R. of the भारतवर्ष. वा. ४५. १००.

--occupies the central position of the globe in the form of a lotus leaf, in extent a १००,000 yojanas. There are nine continents demarcated by moun- tain ranges. In the middle is situated इलावृत, at whose middle portion stands Meru. Some say that eight extra [page१-630+ ३८] countries were attached to it by the sons of Sagara who dug into the earth on all sides in search of sacrificial horse. This द्वीप is surrounded by salt sea.
1: भा. I. १२. 5; V. 1. ३२; १६. 5-7; १९. २९-30; २०. 2; M. ८३. ३२; ११३. 7; १२२. 2; २८४. 2; वा. ११. ८४; ३३. ११ and ४५; ch. ३४. Vi. II. 3. २८.
Contains many जनपदस्, cities, mountains, rivers, nine भुवनस्, salt ocean, six वर्षपर्वतस् and two oceans--east and west. Divided into nine parts among the sons of आग्नीध्र;
2: Br. II. १७. २४, ३०; १५. 8 to the end; १४. ११, ४३ and ५२; Vi. II. 1. १२; 2. २३-25.
from the जम्बु tree.
3: वा. ४६. २५.
--people of, described. See जम्बू. वा. ४६. २५-37.
--R. of honey, containing gold. वा. ३५. २९; ४७. ६६.
--a R. in जम्बूद्वीप famous for gold. Vi. II. 2. २१.

--a तीर्थ with forest near चित्रकूट;
1: Br. III. १३. ३८.
sacred to पितृस्,
2: M. २२. २१.
fit for श्राद्ध;
3: वा. ७७. ३८.
here was born Bharata.
4: Vi. II. १३. ३३.
--R. in इलवृतम्. (perhaps जम्बू, s.v.). Br. II. १७. २२.

(I)--father of कयाधू, and chief of Asuras. Took part in the 6th देवासुर war between Bali and Indra. Fought with वृषा-Kapi. Hearing that Bali had fallen dead Jambha riding on a lion attacked Indra and dis- abled his elephant. He then turned towards मातलि who brought a chariot to Indra's aid. But his head was cut off by Indra's वज्र।
1: भा. VI. १८. १२; VIII. १०. २१-32; ११. १३-18; Br. III. 6. १०; ७२. ८१ and १०५; वा. ९७. १०३.
Led तारक's army in a chariot of १०० lions; fought with Yama, Kubera, जनार्दन and others but was finally killed.
2: M. ४७. ७२; १४८. ४२-54; chh १५०-53; २४५. १२. Vi. IV. 6. १४; V. १४. १४.
[page१-631+ २७]
(II)--a son of भाष्कल. Br. III. 5. ३८.
(III)--a son of Virocana, and father of four sons. वा. ६७. ७६.
--also जृम्भण; a commander to aid विषङ्ग was killed by विजया. Br. IV. २५. २९.
--a तीर्थम् on the Narmada. Here Indra became lord of gods. M. १९४. ३५-6.
--one of the ten daughters of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२५.
--a daughter of दक्ष married to Dhama; her sons were नववीथिस् on the three paths. Br. III. 3. 2, ३३.
--a daughter of दक्ष, and one of the wives of Dharma. Mother of Svarga (नागविथि-वा। प्।). भा. VI. 6. 4 and 6; वा. ६६. ३४; Vi. II. १५. १०५-7.
--a तुषित God. Br. II. ३६. १०.
--a Mt. on the base of Meru; north of the महा- bhadra lake. भा. V. १६. २६; वा. ३६. ३२; Vi. II. 2. २९, ४४.

--the daughter of जाम्बवान् given in mar- riage to कृष्ण (वासुदेव). She claimed Syamantaka as her शुल्क।
1: भा. X. ५६. ३२; ५७. ४१ [3]; 1. ११. १७. Br. III. 7. ३०१; ७१. ४९. २४२-50; वा. ९६. ४७, २३३; Vi. IV. १३. ५५, ६३; १५. ३५; V. २८. 4; ३०. ३५.
Mother of साम्ब and three sons and a daughter.
2: भा. III. 1. ३०; X. ६१. १२; ६३. 1; M. ४६. २६; ४७. १४, १८; Vi. V. ३२. 2.
Welcomed by द्रौपदी to Indraprastha, she narrated to her how she married कृष्ण.
3: भा. X. ७१. ४२; ८३. १०.
Mother of the daughters भद्रा- वती and सम्बोधिनी.
4: वा. ९६. २४१.
[page१-649+ ३५]

--the son of रक्षा and प्रजापति (also जाम्बवत्)--The Lord of ऋक्षस् who celebrated वामन's victory over Bali.
1: भा. VIII. २१. 8; Br. III. 7. ३००-4; Vi. IV. १३. ३२-58.
The same person is said to have been an ally of राम.
2: भा. IX. १०. १९ and ४४.
Killed the lion that killed Prasena (s.v.) and took the स्यमन्तक (s.v.) to his child. कृष्ण and his citizens traced the footsteps of Prasena, which led them to the cave of जाम्बवान्. कृष्ण fought with the latter for twenty-eight days जाम्बवान् acknowledged his defeat and praised Hari. He bestowed his daughter जाम्ब- वती and the jewel on कृष्ण.
3: भा. X. ५६. १४-32; Br. III. ७१. ३५; M. ४५. 7-8, १२-6; वा. ९६. ३४.
Attained salvation by सत्- सन्ग;
4: भा. XI. १२. 6.
present at राम's अभिषेक।
5: Vi. IV. 4. १००.
--gold formed from the earth on the banks of the river जम्बू largely used by celestials. भा. V. १६. २०-21; Br. II. १७. ३०-31; Vi. II. 2. २३.
